lines.en: label kirininviteaff:
scene kirininvitegen
Kirin and I spend the night inside of my room, gorging ourselves on fast food and talking about whatever things cross our minds.
lines.zh: 我和 Kirin 晚上待在我房间里，猛吃快餐，想到什么聊什么。

lines.en: And when I say {i}our{/i} minds, I really just mean hers.
lines.zh: 我说「我们」想到什么，其实只是她。

lines.en: She can be really talkative when there's no one else around.
lines.zh: 没别人在的时候，她话真的很多。

lines.en: And the level of comfort she's been showing with me lately is far surpassing anything I ever expected to get out of her.
lines.zh: 而且她最近对我表现出的自在程度，远远超出我原本对她的期待。

lines.en: Sure, there's still plenty that I don't know about her-
lines.zh: 当然，关于她我不知道的事还有很多——

lines.en: But each hour we spend inside of this room, with me dodging french fries that she tries to force-feed me, somehow brings us closer together.
lines.zh: 但在这间房里度过的每一个小时，我一边躲她硬塞过来的薯条，一边不知怎么就和她又近了一点。

lines.en: There's a certain beauty to moments filled with nothingness like these.
lines.zh: 这种什么都没发生的时刻，有一种特别的美。

lines.en: And that beauty seems to be amplified when those taking part are overflowing with the complete opposite- packed to the brim with those horrible things called {i}feelings{/i}.
lines.zh: 而当参与其中的人心里塞满了完全相反的东西——塞满了那种叫{i}感情{/i}的可怕玩意儿——这种美似乎就被放大了。

lines.en: It's everything and nothing all at once.
lines.zh: 它同时是一切，也是什么都没有。

lines.en: Everything and nothing and french fries.
lines.zh: 一切、什么都没有，还有薯条。

lines.en: Oh, how simple life can be at times.
lines.zh: 啊，生活有时候真简单。

lines.en: scene black
We finish eating and spend the next couple hours playing some trivia game Kirin made me install on my phone.
lines.zh: 吃完之后，接下来几个小时我们都在玩 Kirin 逼我装到手机上的某个问答游戏。

lines.en: She absolutely demolishes me because, apparently, trivia happens to be something that she's really good at for some reason.
lines.zh: 她把我打得毫无还手之力，因为不知为什么，问答恰好是她特别擅长的东西。

lines.en: I have no idea how she developed this skillset and even less of an idea of why she is trying to hone it alongside me, but at least she's having fun.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道她这本事是怎么练出来的，更不明白她为什么非要拉着我一起磨，不过至少她玩得开心。

lines.en: And if getting demolished is able to make her smile, I suppose I'm fine with it every now and then.
lines.zh: 如果被血虐能让她笑，那偶尔来一次我也无所谓。

lines.en: This girl could use more smiles.
lines.zh: 这女孩该多笑一点。

lines.en: For all I know, they might even renew her warped perspective of everyone and everything.
lines.zh: 说不定这还能让她那套扭曲的、对所有人所有事的看法重新鲜活起来。

lines.en: Or everything and nothing.
lines.zh: 或者一切，或者什么都没有。
